import numpy as np
from scipy.fft import fft
from more_itertools import chunked
from sortedcontainers import SortedList
from atcoder.dsu import DSU
d=DSU(3);d.merge(0,1)
assert d.size(0)==2 and list(chunked([1,2,3],2))==[[1,2],[3]] and SortedList([2,1])[0]==1
assert abs(fft(np.array([1.,2.]))[0]-3)<1e-9
print(3)
